summary: 0.13.4 table-sort-dir-spelled-out reported applied with an empty left list while a root-entry `import type { SortDir }` and `computed<SortDir>` stayed unrenamed

evidence.loc: projects/app/src/app/shared/utils/use-list-url.ts:6 `  SortDir,` inside `import type { SortChangeEvent, SortDir } from '@ids-group-ltd/ids-design-system'`

proposal: When an item's action names an exported type rename (SortDir -> SortDirection), either rewrite type imports from the package root or list every occurrence it did not rewrite under `left`, so `applied` with no left really means done.

summary: deleteList row `find` is a string ("rescaleOnHide") where every other row carries an array
proposal: Make it ["rescaleOnHide"] and add a schema check that `find` is an array; a consumer iterating it greps single characters.

summary: bare `preventDefault()` find shape hits ordinary form-submit handlers
proposal: Drop the bare shape or pair it with `emit(!this.checked())` / a ds-switch host.

summary: drift-scan reports gone class `html` on a SCSS comment line that names the <html> element

evidence.loc: projects/app/src/styles.scss:7 `// The brand layer (2-5) activates via <html data-brand="app"> (see index.html).`

proposal: Skip comment lines and match class names only in a `.name` selector position.

summary: a 19-version chain with 337 items against a consumer with 112 source files would need ~19 planners + ~90 finder and ~90 recheck dispatches; 9 items had any hit
proposal: Add a cheap whole-chain pre-pass (dry-run script + lint over the full range + one finder per version range) and dispatch per-item planners/finders/rechecks only for items with rawMatches > 0; the run here used 6 range finders and rechecked only the 6 applied items.
